observed.source_model: R3 four-joint arm; PG3 old C7 candidate; six asymmetric scanfit outer envelopes; D405 long R5 candidate
observed.visual: White cap stands on motor box on same tabletop as arm base; latest arm is hand-supported/cropped; tips closed; images inspected directly.
observed.servo_to_cad: Uncalibrated zero, sign and mounting phase. Counts are not inserted as CAD qpos.
observed.camera_variant: 65deg selected as nominal; 65 versus75 actual revision remains unknown.
observed.source_viewer_limits: gravity0/contactdisabled/noactuator/noequalities; passive sliders and two mocap links; not a dynamics model
observed.scanfit: cot_L/R,foam_L/R,band_L/R: six asymmetric outer occupancy shapes. Native STL/STEP millimetres CAD Z-up. GLB metres Y-up=(x,z,-y)/1000. No invented inner cores or separate unconfirmed pads.

nominal.scene_geometry_status: Fixed before model/IK: independent D435 raw-depth table/box analysis; no camera-to-base calibration.

softtip.status: Unmeasured nominal compliant contact, not a deformable or force-calibrated material model

nominal.actuator_bound_basis: ROBOTIS vendor stall1.5Nm@12V is momentary; use lower bounded nominal model, no claim of continuous rating or PWM conversion
nominal.scan_attachment: Native frame datum aligns with C7 construction axes. Photo L (negativeX) attaches to C7 jaw_L, positiveX to jaw_R. Scan aperture angle is unknown; theta90 attachment is explicit nominal registration, unchanged source meshes.
nominal.joint_limits_status: Inherited viewer construction intervals, not verified hardware safety limits

box.basis: Independent D435 plane estimate49.3mm; base-to-cap observed table separation0.17–0.19m. 64mm footprint nominal from D405 image/depth. Base X/Y yaw not calibrated; nominal target along forward+Y.

contact_solver.basis: Official MuJoCo documents soft-contact slow slip even within friction cone; impratio increases tangential/normal impedance ratio without increasing physical coefficient. Diagnose at same geometry, mu0.7 and force bounds. Final half-timestep sensitivity required.

design.jaw: One driven crank hinge plus two passive slider/rod loops; no runtime kinematic qpos/mocap placement. Exact C7 nonlinear closure transmits force through equality connect constraints.
design.geometry: Unmodified visual mesh copies; collision decomposition/proxies stored separately with error report. Only one camera-holder variant active.
design.units: SI metres, kilograms, seconds, radians; original CAD and scan units explicitly converted
design.camera: Preserve each sensor's original depth/color K and nonzero RGB distortion; synthetic wrist camera is D405-equivalent nominal perspective, not calibrated real reprojection. No raw camera pixel/point is treated as base coordinates.
design.environment: Dedicated runs/sim-cap-grasp Python3.12 uv environment; original source dependency environments unchanged
design.safety: Offline simulation only, no serial/camera/live servers/hardware writes. Cap freejoint under gravity, no weld/mocap/external force/direct qpos writes after reset. Arm driven only through finite actuators.
